profile.headline: Senior Wordpress Developer | Custom Themes, JavaScript | An Eye for Design. A Focus on Performance. A Commitment to Clean Code.
profile.summary:
Senior WordPress Developer and Web Developer specializing in building fast, accessible, scalable websites and custom digital experiences.

I bring strong experience across WordPress, PHP, JavaScript, HTML/CSS, custom theme and plugin development, Gutenberg, ACF, multisite, and modern front-end development. My work ranges from large-scale website rebuilds and CMS architecture to performance optimization, accessibility, integrations, content migrations, and ongoing platform improvements.

I’m especially focused on creating clean, maintainable solutions that make websites easier for both users and content teams to work with. I’ve built reusable component systems, custom WordPress functionality, multisite platforms, and responsive experiences with WCAG accessibility and performance in mind.

I also incorporate AI tools such as ChatGPT and Codex into development workflows to accelerate research, debugging, documentation, and implementation while maintaining strong engineering standards.

Core strengths: WordPress Development • PHP • JavaScript • HTML5/CSS3 • Gutenberg • ACF • Custom Themes & Plugins • WordPress Multisite • Accessibility/WCAG • Performance Optimization • Responsive Development • CMS Architecture

positions.title: WordPress Web Developer
positions.description:
• Developed custom WordPress themes and plugins to enhance website functionality and SEO performance.
• Collaborated with clients to create responsive, mobile-first designs for seamless user experience.
• Conducted smooth content migrations to WordPress, ensuring data integrity and SEO value preservation.
positions.insights: Skills: Wordpress Development · Website Performance · W3C Accessibility · SEO · ACF Development · Web Design · MySQL · Adobe Photoshop · Front-end Development

positions.title: Senior Wordpress Developer
positions.description:
-Built a WordPress Multisite and Full Site Editing (FSE) platform for a primary brand site and more than 60 franchise microsites.
-Created reusable Gutenberg blocks with ACF so marketing teams could build on-brand pages without developer support.
-Wrote shared MU-plugins and multisite-aware theme code to manage common features across franchise sites. 
-Set up editorial controls that limited block options and kept page layouts consistent with design standards.
-Applied design tokens, optimized asset delivery, and addressed WCAG accessibility requirements across the front-end.

positions.title: Wordpress Developer
positions.description:
Maintain and develop flexible content modules within a headless Wordpress architecture using Sveltekit, Vercel, Patheon, ACF and Figma.
Assist the Marketing team with publishing press releases, cookie management, search engine optimization and GA configuration.
positions.insights: Skills: WordPress · Svelte · Search Engine Optimization (SEO) · Digital Marketing · Content Management Systems (CMS)

positions.title: Wordpress Developer
positions.description:
Deliver comprehensive Wordpress development services for agency clients.
Created custom solutions aligned with client needs while maintaining quality and design consistency standards.
Implemented complex site functionality, including plugin configurations and content migrations, ensuring optimal user experience.
Tech Stack: Wordpress, ACF, Beanstalk, Cloudflare
positions.insights: Skills: WordPress · PHP · ACF Development · Debugging

positions.title: Senior Wordpress Developer
positions.description:
• Spearheaded maintenance and strategic updates of the company's primary marketing website infrastructure.
• Led development of innovative 100% component-based WordPress theme using advanced technology stack.
• Managed Linux server provisioning and implemented automated deployment workflows for seamless operations.
positions.insights: Skills: Twig (Template Engine) · W3C Accessibility · WP · ACF Development · MySQL · Theme Development · WordPress

positions.title: Wordpress Developer
positions.description:
• Collaborated with Apache Corporation's creative team to develop and launch a redesigned WordPress site, focusing on CMS content styling, PHP functions, plugin configuration, and API development.
• Implemented front-end development solutions to enhance user experience and site functionality for Apache Corporation's WordPress platform.
• Successfully migrated the newly designed WordPress site to launch, ensuring seamless integration and optimal performance for users.
positions.insights: Skills: Wordpress Development · Website Performance · WP · SEO · ACF Development · Front-end Development

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
• Executed full stack WordPress development responsibilities for Snap! Mobile's flagship marketing site, including custom theme development and plugin architecture.
• Demonstrated expertise in Advanced Custom Fields (ACF) implementation and dynamic block development for enhanced content management.
• Orchestrated seamless integration with multiple testing, tracking, and analytics platforms to optimize site performance and user experience.
positions.insights: Skills: Wordpress Development · Website Performance · WP · SEO · ACF Development · Web Design · MySQL · Adobe Photoshop · Front-end Development

positions.title: Wordpress Developer
positions.description:
• Developed and maintained enterprise-wide intranet and directory tools using WordPress architecture.
• Managed CMS using HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, jQuery, and PHP.
• Provided technical support and bug fixes.
• Implemented responsive design across devices.
positions.insights: Skills: Wordpress Development · Website Performance · ACF Development · Front-end Development

positions.title: Wordpress Developer
positions.description:
• Developed custom blocks using ACF framework with Laravel Blade templating for enhanced content management flexibility.
• Utilized LAMP stack architecture with NPM build tools to optimize development workflows and deployment processes.
• Ensured seamless integration of front-end and back-end components in WordPress using PHP for peak performance standards.
positions.insights: Skills: Wordpress Development · Website Performance · WP · SEO · ACF Development · Front-end Development

positions.title: Wordpress Developer
positions.description:
• Developed websites for agency clients using WordPress, Squarespace, and Drupal platforms.
• Implemented site functionality, content migration, and responsive design.
• Optimized web assets for speed and performance.
• Created site layout and user interface using HTML/CSS/SCSS/JS/PHP practices.
positions.insights: Skills: Wordpress Development · Website Performance · WP · SEO · ACF Development · Adobe Photoshop · Front-end Development

positions.title: Frontend Web Developer
positions.description:
• Developed highly responsive and user-friendly interfaces for prestigious agency clients like Wells Fargo and Ubiquity within WordPress environments.
• Implemented modern design patterns and best practices to ensure optimal user experience across all devices.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
• Completed front-end development tasks to ensure optimal user accessibility and clean interfaces.
• Collaborated with designers to optimize user experience and interactions on websites.
• Specialized in front-end WordPress development using HTML5, CSS preprocessors, jQuery, and PHP.
• Built custom plugins and widgets for WordPress websites.

• Implemented seamless third-party API integrations and optimized front-end build processes.

positions.title: Creative Web Developer- Contractor
positions.description: Corporate branding of hybrid Legacy/Bootstrap white label sites, logo reproduction, icon branding, pattern designer, front-end change requests/maintenance.

positions.title: Front-end development/UI Prototyping - E-Commerce Division
positions.description:
• Utilized HTML5, LESS, jQuery, and Bootstrap 3 to develop responsive designs for CMS admin, landing pages, and email marketing.
• Redesigned user experience for the company's .NET based e-Commerce website.
• Contracted as a designer to deliver wireframes and mock-ups for new e-commerce features.
